info.title: ai-catalog
info.description: CLI tool for working with AI Catalog documents (application/ai-catalog+json). Migrate, export, publish, explore, and install AI artifacts.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: AI Catalog CLI — migrate, export, publish, explore, validate, and install AI artifacts

commands.name: migrate
commands.description: Migrate a marketplace.json to AI Catalog format

commands.name: export
commands.description: Export an AI Catalog to the unified plugin marketplace layout

options.name: --output
options.description: Output directory for generated plugin marketplace files

options.name: --source-dir
options.description: Base directory for resolving relative plugin source paths (defaults to the input file directory)

commands.name: publish
commands.description: Package a catalog for remote distribution (zip, sign, host)

options.name: --output
options.description: Output directory for packaged catalog artifacts

commands.name: explore
commands.description: Fetch and browse an AI Catalog from a URL

options.name: --show
options.description: Show details for an entry by identifier

arguments.name: URL
arguments.description: URL of an AI Catalog document

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Validate an AI Catalog document and its local artifacts

commands.name: install
commands.description: Install an artifact from an AI Catalog

options.name: --type
options.description: Artifact type hint: mcp or skill (auto-detected from mediaType if omitted)

options.name: --output-dir
options.description: Base directory for installation (defaults to current directory)

arguments.name: ENTRY_ID
arguments.description: Identifier of the entry to install
